Package eu.cloudhopper.mc.provider.springboot

Class Identities

java.lang.Object
eu.cloudhopper.mc.provider.springboot.Identities
public final class Identities extends Object
Which functions an instance of the application serves. Targets that deploy one unit per identity (Knative, Scaleway: one service or container per @Function(identity), the functions without one in the default unit) run the same application several times and set CLOUDHOPPER_IDENTITY for each: an instance then answers only the endpoints of the functions of its identity, so that a function cannot be reached through an instance with other permissions. Without the variable (e.g. springboot-http) it serves all functions.

The check runs on every request, not as a Spring condition: in a native image, Spring AOT fixes the beans at build time, and one image serves all identities.
